title: A Neural Attention Model for Abstractive Sentence Summarization

numbers.sentence: Gigaword contains around 9.5 million news articles sourced from various domestic and international news services over the last two decades.
For reference, the best human evaluator scores 31.7 ROUGE-1.
Best validation accuracy is reached after 15 epochs through the data, which requires around 4 days of training.

edges.sentence: We also report the winning system on this shared task, Topiary [Zajic et al. 2004]. Topiary merges a compression system using linguistically-motivated transformations of the input [Dorr et al. 2003] with an unsupervised topic detection (UTD) algorithm that appends key phrases from the full article onto the compressed output. woodsend2010generation (described above) also report results on the DUC dataset.
